dct_description_sm:
Water cytotoxicity testing results are calculated values. Raw data files can be provided upon request.
Any abbreviation erroneously excluded from the dataset metadata can be found in the associated report, "Analysis, Evaluation and Reporting of Environmental Monitoring Data for the Lower Athabasca River".

This dataset contains all water cytotoxicity testing data used for analysis in the report, "Analysis, Evaluation and Reporting of Environmental Monitoring Data for the Lower Athabasca River". The analyzed water samples were collected in 2018-2019 and 2021 from surface waters in the Lower Athabasca River basin in Northern Alberta, Canada. The samples were collected for a three year baseline monitoring program completed by Alberta Environment and Protected Areas (AEPA).
dct_title_s: Cytotoxicity Dataset for: Analysis, Evaluation and Reporting of Environmental Monitoring Data for the Lower Athabasca River
